note: Conseil de prud'hommes procedure, mostly R articles. These are short, formulaic and full of shared vocabulary ('bureau de conciliation et d'orientation' appears in a dozen of them), which makes the category a precision stress test rather than a recall one.

cases.query: compétence du conseil de prud'hommes pour les litiges individuels du travail
cases.note: L1411-4 carries the exclusivity rule that makes the competence useful in a pleading, so it is primary alongside the definition.

cases.query: comment saisir le conseil de prud'hommes forme de la demande
cases.note: R1452-1 is two sentences and includes the interruption-of-prescription rule a practitioner needs. Very short R articles are the weak point of the vector arm.

cases.query: référé prud'homal provision sur une créance non sérieusement contestable
cases.note: Statutory-vocabulary twin of voc-010. Comparing the two shows how much of the score comes from the query's wording rather than from the retrieval design.

cases.query: délai pour faire appel d'un jugement du conseil de prud'hommes
cases.note: Near-miss by construction: R1461-1 (one month, jugement) and R1455-11 (fifteen days, référé) are both 'délai d'appel'. Returning only the second answers a different question.

cases.query: représentation obligatoire par avocat devant la chambre sociale de la cour d'appel
cases.note: Two adjacent articles that share a subject; the query's discriminating term ('chambre sociale') appears in exactly one of them.

cases.query: pouvoirs du bureau de conciliation et d'orientation en cas d'échec de la conciliation
cases.note: Fifteen articles in this corpus contain the phrase 'bureau de conciliation et d'orientation'. The discriminating term is 'échec de la conciliation', which appears in two. Pure precision@5 case.

cases.query: que se passe-t-il si le défendeur ne se présente pas devant le bureau de conciliation
cases.note: The Code says 'ne comparaît pas'; the query says 'ne se présente pas'. A one-word vocabulary hop inside an otherwise dense lexical field — the case most likely to be won by the vector arm alone.

cases.query: audience de départage devant le juge départiteur en cas de partage des voix
cases.note: The word 'départiteur' appears in only two articles, so the lexical arm should win outright. Included as the counterweight to pro-007.

cases.query: qui peut assister ou représenter un salarié devant le conseil de prud'hommes
cases.note: L1453-1A has an unusual article number (letter suffix, no hyphen) that also exercises the citation-label parsing in the harness, not only retrieval.

cases.query: requalification d'une convention de stage en contrat de travail devant le bureau de jugement
cases.note: Single gold, one article, one sentence, in a chapter about something else. If a strategy cannot isolate it, it is returning the section rather than the rule.

cases.query: prise d'acte de la rupture par le salarié saisine directe du bureau de jugement
cases.note: 'Prise d'acte' is jurisprudential vocabulary the Code never uses — it says 'demande de qualification de la rupture ... à l'initiative du salarié'. A vocabulary gap hiding inside a procedural query.

cases.query: exécution provisoire et titre exécutoire du procès-verbal de conciliation
cases.note: Very short R articles again, and 'titre exécutoire' appears exactly once in the corpus. Expected to be an easy lexical win and a hard vector one.
